answer: An agent market trading onyx, basalt, and tundra survey feeds can deter Sybils with slashable collateral. Each node locks a minimum token stake in an escrow contract bound to its keypair, and peers submit fraud proofs to slash that stake upon equivocation or invalid state transitions. Creating fake accounts thus incurs scarce liquid capital and verifiable opportunity cost per identity. However, wealthy adversaries can still fund many compliant Sybils to gain outsized influence.
